reliability.rationale: All saved predictions and primary metrics independently reproduce from source-verified inputs, including unfavorable alternatives. Whole deposition batch4 is held with three wafers and nine spectra. Fringed Fresnel response improves counts prediction, but the effective8.64nm period is not certified film thickness; one batch cannot support population uncertainty.
